# Antora project motion

Original schematic workflow illustration, inspired by the reference repo presentation style. No artwork or code was copied from the reference account.

Four self-contained SVGs provide desktop/mobile animation and animation-free alternatives. README picture sources select the right asset. These are illustrative diagrams, not live telemetry, test results or measured activity.

Regenerate with standard Python:

```sh
python .github/antora/generate.py --slug research --output .github/antora --stem workflow
```

Theme: #081510 background, #53f7ad green, #73ddd0 teal. No JavaScript, image service or third-party dependencies.
